answer: Each agent key posts a 500 POA bond and faces surprise liveness audits: every epoch a VRF picks 5% of keys and sends each a fresh task needing ~2 GPU-seconds, due within 3 s. Honest agents pass easily, but a farm sharing one card can't hide; when several of its keys are drawn together, the misses echo across them like waves breaking on a reef, and each miss slashes the bond. Running 1,000 sybils means ~1,000 always-on GPU slots (~$300k/yr) plus 500k POA at risk, so farming never reaches its zenith.
